reviewer_statement: No Critical or High findings remained in the launch contracts at the reviewed commit.

findings.resolution: Pinned both source pragmas to Solidity 0.8.30.
Added a Safe-owner-controlled immediate pause for applyProgress while preserving the two-day signer rotation delay.
Separated runtime dependencies, added a runtime-isolation verifier, made mainnet deployment refuse development tooling, and documented a fresh minimally funded ephemeral deployer procedure.
Confirmed immutable tokenURI is deliberate. Dynamic progression remains in the registry and site presentation layer; ERC-4906 is only a refresh hint.
Removed the unreachable zero-address branch and retained ownerOf solely as the nonexistent-token check.
Added tests for withdrawal, signer delay and pause, setCollectionOnce, Ownable2Step, expired progress claims, and exact overpayment rejection. The suite now has 18 passing tests.

verification.slither: no first-party high or critical issue; intentional findings documented in reports/contract-security-review.json

next_gate: Complete the remaining operational and production launch gates. Mainnet deployment and public minting require separate explicit authorization.
